text.arabic_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

baseline.text: Bu gününüzle karşılaşmayı unuttuğunuz için tadın! Biz de sizi unuttuk. Yaptıklarınız yüzünden sonsuzluk azabını tadın!

findings.text: Aynı unutma kökünün iki özneyle yinelenmesi, ilahî unutmayı hafıza kusuru değil, onların karşılaşmayı sürekli ihmaline karşılık gelen ölçülü bir terk ediş yapar.
Gelecekteki yüz yüze karşılaşmayı önemsememek, gün hazır olduğunda onu kaçınılmaz ve doğrudan yaşanan bir bilgiye dönüştürür.
İki kez tadın denmesi ve sonsuzluğun adlandırılması, tadı kısa bir temas olmaktan çıkarıp sürekli eylemin kalıcı sonucuna giriş yapar.
Tatma alanındaki tatlı su ve yoksun bırakma çağrışımları, azabı iyi ve besleyici olandan mahrum bırakılan olumsuz bir ağırlanma biçimi gibi düşündürebilir.

activation_trace.role: Direct experience and trial make the commands an enforced knowing of what had remained dismissible.
Leaving and neglecting supplies the reciprocal relation: an abandoned encounter is answered by abandonment.
Two sides coming face to face makes the neglected object a real confrontation rather than a date merely forgotten.
Intentional action makes the resulting exposure answer sustained agency rather than an accidental lapse.

changed_reading.after: Neglect of the coming confrontation is reciprocally enacted upon them, and tasting forces the encounter into direct experience as the answer to intentional practice.
changed_reading.before: A punishment is announced because people forgot a future appointment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled commands from ذ و ق, the matched clauses from ن س ي, the encounter noun from ل ق ي, and the causal closing formula tied to ع م ل.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah converts a meeting they left unattended into unavoidable first-person experience. The two uses of forgetting form a reciprocal social action rather than two equal cognitive lapses: their neglect of the encounter is answered by being left without regard, while intended work fixes responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Becoming a condition after separation lets tasting function as transition into a state, not only sampling it.
Persistence resistant to decay supplies the new state's temporal character.
Adhesion and remaining in place sharpen permanence as being unable to detach from the condition.
The day as a severe event supplies the threshold at which the state change occurs.
Past temporal presence links the new persistent condition to what their doing had repeatedly been.

changed_reading.after: The severe day is a threshold where tasting names a forced change of condition, and الخلد names adhesion to the condition entered.
changed_reading.before: Taste is a brief sensory metaphor for a punishment that happens to last forever.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from ذوقوا to عذاب الخلد, with يوم and كنتم marking event and prior temporal state.
baseline_models.mechanism: A verb that can mark becoming a condition after separation sits beside persistence and adhesion. The command therefore need not describe a momentary sample of a long penalty; it can mark entry into a condition whose defining property is that it does not quickly pass away.

activation_trace.role: The discarded and unregarded object supplies a social-status image for both sides of the reversal.
Face-to-face encounter anchors what they had treated as negligible and what now becomes unavoidable.
Deliberate leaving keeps the reversal in the domain of enacted neglect rather than literal divine amnesia.

changed_reading.after: It stages a reversal of regard: those who cast the encounter aside are themselves cast outside protective regard.
changed_reading.before: The verse uses conventional reciprocal wording for forgetting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ن س ي surrounds لقاء يومكم and permits the neglected-object branch to interact with the reciprocal syntax.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch image of a discarded, negligible object makes the first forgetting an enacted valuation: the meeting was treated as something thrown aside. The answer reverses positions, making the neglecters themselves the ones left outside regard.

activation_trace.role: Leaving and neglecting anchors the focus consequence as enacted non-response.
Recall after forgetfulness supplies an early opportunity for the encounter to be brought back to mind.
An active reminder supplies the contrasting case in which recollection produces an embodied response.
Recollection immediately before turning away makes the failure persist after memory has been refreshed.

changed_reading.after: They repeatedly received memory-restoring cues yet maintained non-response, so reciprocal forgetting reads as the consequence of volitional neglect.
changed_reading.before: They failed to remember the meeting.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated reminders precede the focus: creation invites recollection, signs cause one group to respond bodily, and another person turns away after being reminded. This sequence makes نسيتم in the focus less like information that slipped from memory and more like maintained non-response to restored memory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated recall and contrasting responses; I infer that continued non-response converts lapse into neglect, while the live alternative is ordinary forgetfulness that hardens only after repetition.
structural_cues: The reminder root recurs at 32:4, 32:15, and 32:22, with sharply different responses.
At 32:22, reminder is followed by ثم and an explicit turning-away construction.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face convergence anchors the encounter that the dispersal claim attempts to cancel.
The cast-off object lets neglect overlap with an imagined self lost among discarded matter.
Loss of a thing supplies the material premise that bodily dispersal means irrecoverability.
The same convergence branch names precisely the meeting denied after the dispersal question.
Veiling the truth turns the material question into active concealment of the encounter's claim.

changed_reading.after: They tried to abolish the meeting by construing dispersed embodiment as unrecoverable; the focus answers imagined disappearance with unavoidable convergence and experience.
changed_reading.before: The meeting was neglected as a future religious claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers imagine themselves lost in the earth and use that imagined disappearance to deny renewed creation and encounter. Forgetting the meeting can thus be read not only as ignoring an appointment but as trying to make the meeting ontologically impossible by treating the self as unrecoverable material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material loss followed by denial of encounter; I infer that the first is used to authorize the second, while an alternative is that the clauses merely place two independent denials side by side.
structural_cues: The بل pivot in 32:10 moves from a question about dispersal in earth to denial of meeting.
The focus reuses لقاء and answers attempted disappearance with direct tasting.

activation_trace.role: Experience and trial make tasting the final, compulsory mode of knowing.
Auditory perception is supplied before judgment as an available capacity.
Visual perception is likewise supplied before the later confession.
The claim of now seeing marks belated direct perception.
Hearing as understanding and compliance clarifies what was missing when hearing was merely available.
The requested return supplies the desired but unavailable bridge from new certainty back to action.
Intended action is what the speakers now propose to change after perception.
Stable knowledge without doubt names the epistemic result that arrives too late.

changed_reading.after: Tasting is also forced verification: ignored knowledge becomes bodily certainty precisely when certainty can no longer be converted into different work.
changed_reading.before: Tasting intensifies the pain of punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing and sight are first given but receive little gratitude; later the offenders say that they now see and hear, declare certainty, and ask to return so they can act. Tasting in the focus completes this sensory sequence as knowledge forced into the body only after the interval in which knowledge could guide work has closed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capacities, belated perception, certainty, and a request to resume action; I infer that tasting completes an epistemic progression, while the alternative is that taste denotes pain without extending the seeing-hearing sequence.
structural_cues: The sequence runs from granted senses in 32:9 to the first-person confession of seeing and hearing in 32:12, then to tasting in 32:14.
The request to return grammatically precedes the proposed righteous action.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work anchors punishment to what the addressees themselves practiced.
Experienced tasting makes the prepared reception personally inhabited rather than abstractly awarded.
Concealment marks a prepared outcome that remains unavailable to present perception.
An act met by its corresponding recompense supplies the work-to-outcome relation.
The matching work root establishes the positive side of the parallel causal formula.
Joining a sheltering destination supplies reception as an inhabited outcome.
Provisions prepared for an arriving guest turn recompense into a reception already made ready.
The doubled work occurrence ties both righteous practice and its lodging to the same agency.

changed_reading.after: Prior work prepares a mode of reception: the righteous enter provisioned shelter, while the focus addressees enter and personally taste the reception their practice has prepared.
changed_reading.before: Punishment is imposed in proportion to prior deeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same work formula frames hidden recompense and a prepared lodging for those who act rightly, then frames tasted punishment in the focus. The positive reception activates a negative counterpart: deeds do not merely earn a later sentence; they prepare the kind of reception into which the agent arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored work formulas, recompense, and guest provision; I infer a positive-to-negative reception symmetry, while the alternative is a simpler legal equivalence with no hospitality mechanism.
structural_cues: 32:17, 32:19, and 32:14 share the causal formula built around بما, كان, and عمل.
The hidden reward and prepared lodging precede the focus's negative work formula.

activation_trace.role: Adhesion and continued residence anchor permanence as inability to detach from the state.
Trial and experience supply the feedback event that can be either corrective or terminal.
Passage to the outside supplies the repeatedly attempted escape vector.
Return after departure closes every attempted exit back into the same state.
The split root's time-counting recurrence adds a form-distant image of iteration to the repeated return.
The repeated tasting command identifies the loop itself as enforced experience.
Pain and penalty specify what is experienced on each reinstatement.
Contradiction of truth identifies the prior stance that terminal feedback now verifies.
Experience of the nearer penalty supplies the still-corrective version of tasting.
Nearness locates a preliminary consequence before the greater one.
Return from wrongdoing supplies the corrective purpose still open at the nearer stage.

changed_reading.after: Eternity is dynamically enacted as feedback with no remaining corrective exit: every motion outward folds back into the state being tasted.
changed_reading.before: Eternal punishment is static duration after judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nearby punishment can be tasted as corrective feedback with return still intended, but the fire scene makes every attempted exit cause reinstatement. Against that contrast, عذاب الخلد is a topology of failed return: the provisional sample has become a recurrent enclosure whose feedback can no longer redirect action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies corrective tasting, hoped-for return, attempted exit, and forced recurrence; I infer a threshold where feedback ceases to correct and becomes enclosure, while the alternative is that the scenes only distinguish degrees of pain.
structural_cues: The كلما construction in 32:20 encodes an indefinitely repeated attempt-and-reversal loop.
32:21 explicitly contrasts nearer and greater punishment and attaches hoped-for return only to the nearer tasting.

activation_trace.role: A severe event makes your day the decisive occurrence rather than an ordinary date.
The form-distant delay branch supplies postponement as an exploratory undertone to forgetting.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood defines the day's decisive function.
The severe-event branch links the focus day to the narrated judgment boundary.
Divergent paths supply what judgment finally separates and resolves.
Judicial opening paradoxically supplies the closure that decides what had remained contested.
The negated benefit marks the point after which a changed stance cannot alter the outcome.
Waiting and granting time, under negation, make the boundary one of no further respite.

changed_reading.after: Your day is the adjudicative boundary they kept functionally postponing, where truth opens by closing dispute and all further extension.
changed_reading.before: Your day is the date they failed to keep in mind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's your day is activated by a day of separation and a day whose opening is judicial closure: disagreement is decided, late belief has no utility, and no extension is granted. The delay branch near نسي then becomes a cautious echo: what was continually postponed arrives as the boundary beyond which postponement is impossible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decision, judicial opening, useless late belief, and no respite; I infer that these convert your day into a no-deferral boundary, while the delay resonance in نسي remains optional because its branch is morphologically distant.
structural_cues: The question about the opening in 32:28 is answered by the day of opening in 32:29.
Two coordinated negations in 32:29 remove both late benefit and added time.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work supplies the sustained productive activity whose consequence matures.
Food tasting anchors the outcome as something taken into the body rather than merely observed.
Driving something onward supplies the initiated causal movement toward production.
Conveying water by irrigation supplies the enabling input that makes latent growth possible.
Land stripped of vegetation supplies the initially unproductive substrate.
Growth and cultivation supply the transformation from repeated input to a produced crop.
Harvest supplies the terminal stage at which accumulated production becomes available as consequence.
Eating supplies bodily intake of what the process has produced.
The split mapping's image of encompassing totality adds an exploratory sense of fully assimilating the produced result.

changed_reading.after: They ingest the matured yield of a practice: work has accumulated like cultivation until its product becomes the agent's own tasted environment.
changed_reading.before: They taste a penalty externally assigned because of their deeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late ecological sequence drives water to stripped earth, brings out a crop, and ends in eating. It activates the focus's عمل-to-ذوق relation as production and ingestion: repeated acts are like cultivation whose grown consequence eventually becomes what the agent must take into the self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material production-to-consumption chain and the focus supplies work-to-tasting causality; I analogize deeds to cultivation and recompense to harvest, while the live alternative is that the agricultural scene only demonstrates visible power.
structural_cues: 32:27 presents an explicit serial chain: driving water, reviving stripped ground, producing crop, then eating.
The focus likewise places causal بما عملتم immediately after the command to taste.

remaining_uncertainties: The state-transition branch of ذ و ق may describe a lexical possibility without governing this imperative.
The discarded-object branch of ن س ي sharpens the social reversal but may over-materialize ordinary neglect.
The non-dominant split mappings for ع و د and ء ك ل are diagnostic echoes, not necessary supports.
The delay branch of ن س ي is form-distant and should never displace the stronger forgetting and leaving branches.
The cultivation-to-harvest mechanism is a context-driven analogy rather than an explicit metaphor in the focus.
strongest_changes: Reciprocal forgetting becomes enacted abandonment after repeated reminders, not symmetric cognitive lapse.
Tasting becomes belated bodily certainty that arrives after certainty can still redirect work.
Permanence becomes a failed-return loop contrasted with nearer corrective tasting.
Mirrored work formulas recast outcomes as prepared receptions, with an exploratory extension from cultivation to ingested harvest.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is unusually productive at the junction of sensory knowledge, reciprocal regard, and temporal closure. Context does not collapse these into one explanation: it keeps legal recompense, forced epistemology, social abandonment, dynamic enclosure, hospitality reversal, and material harvest as coexisting mechanisms.

activation_trace.role: Tasting food supplies ingestion and intimate discrimination of what enters the mouth.
Sweet and palatable water supplies the positive sensory pole that the punishment noun violently reverses.
Pain and penalty supply the actual referent, containing the sweetness branch as inversion rather than substitution.

changed_reading.after: The wording stages anti-nourishment: a normally discriminating, potentially pleasant intake is inverted so that pain must be taken inward and known intimately.
changed_reading.before: Taste is simply an idiom meaning suffer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The collision between food-tasting, sweet palatable substance, and punishment is surprising and branch-distant, but all three branches are directly anchored in ذوقوا عذاب. Carry it only as a lexical inversion that intensifies internalization, not as an etymological claim that punishment derives from sweetness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The immediate construction pairing the command from ذ و ق with the noun from ع ذ ب.

activation_trace.role: Delay and extension supply the form-distant possibility that forgetting was lived as continual postponement.
Convergence anchors the event whose arrival cannot be postponed indefinitely.
The severe event supplies the terminal time at which postponement becomes presence.
Waiting and granting time are explicitly negated, closing the temporal extension.
Mutual waiting immediately before closure keeps deferred expectation active as the surah ends.

changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, they kept converting the meeting into later until their day arrived as the point at which no later remained.
changed_reading.before: They mentally forgot that a day of meeting would occur.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading نسيتم through the hamzated delay branch is morphologically distant and cannot replace ordinary forgetting or neglect. It remains worth carrying as a temporal echo because the focus says your day and the ending repeatedly withholds further respite; downstream prose should mark it as resonance, not lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The conjunction of نسيتم, لقاء, and يومكم within the focus, followed later by explicit negation of respite.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Reciprocal abandonment, not symmetrical amnesia.** **ن س ي B002** supplies leaving or abandoning a covenant or command and divine leaving as recompense; **ذ و ق B002** supplies undergoing an experience. The repeated نسي is bound by بِمَا into a stated causal relation. The packet gives the acts and consequence; I infer that the second "forgetting" answers the first as measured abandonment. The ayah reads as enacted reciprocity, not a claim of failed divine recall.
2. **A missed encounter becomes an enduring condition.** **ل ق ي B004** supplies face-to-face encounter, **ي و م B003** an event-day, **ع ذ ب B005** punishment, and **خ ل د B001** enduring permanence. The first taste concerns neglect of a meeting; the second names the lasting state produced by habitual action. I infer that refusing temporal encounter hardens into continuous consequence. The "day" is therefore not just a date forgotten but an appointment whose neglected relation becomes durable.
3. **Punishment as deprivation of palatable provision (exploratory).** Beside punishment in **ع ذ ب B005**, **ع ذ ب B001-B003** supplies sweet water, abstention, and withholding; ذوق makes this taste-field unusually audible. Later, believers receive prepared guest-provision (32:19), whereas fire-dwellers repeatedly taste punishment (32:20). I infer a negative-provision mechanism: what they taste is the withholding of the good sustenance available in the alternative abode. This reading coexists with direct torment rather than replacing it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The prepared **نُزُلًا** of 32:19 and repeated tasting in 32:20 sharpened the contrast between hospitality and punitive experience. The water and food chain in 32:27 made the dormant sweet-water and abstention branches of **ع ذ ب** materially vivid.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The repeated root turns neglect into reciprocal abandonment.** In the first *nasītum*, `ن س ي:B001` permits forgetting and `ن س ي:B002` permits abandoning or neglecting; in the divine reply, `ن س ي:B002` specifically supports leaving as recompense rather than a lapse of memory. Reversed subjects and the causal *bimā* make the relation explicit. **Inferred arrow:** their sustained neglect of the encounter -> corresponding abandonment to its consequence. The repetition changes “we have forgotten you” from defective recall into measured reciprocity.

2. **A refused encounter becomes unavoidable experience.** `ل ق ي:B004` is face-to-face encounter, while the repeated imperative uses `ذ و ق:B002`, undergoing or directly experiencing punishment, beyond ordinary tasting in `ذ و ق:B001`. “This day” deictically collapses the distance that allowed the meeting to be neglected. **Inferred arrow:** refusal to orient toward a future encounter -> compelled experiential knowledge when it becomes present. Taste is the mechanism by which an abstractly neglected meeting becomes immediate and undeniable.

3. **Repeated tasting opens into duration rather than a momentary sample.** `خ ل د:B001` supplies enduring permanence, and the command *dhūqū* occurs twice around the reciprocal-neglect clause. The final *bimā kuntum taʿmalūn* gives sustained prior action as cause. **Inferred arrow:** repeated action -> direct requital -> an enduring state. The second command prevents “taste” from shrinking the punishment to a brief contact; it is entry into the lasting consequence named by *al-khuld*.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 32:17 and 32:19 repeated the work-to-recompense construction on the opposite side of the outcome. That symmetry showed that reciprocal neglect in 32:14 is not an isolated punitive wordplay; it is one instance of a broader rule in which sustained action returns as a matching experienced state.

words.gloss_range: consequential connector opening the punishment command as direct result and immediate address
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the command that follows sound like the enacted consequence of the previous decree, not a fresh isolated order. It also turns the prior third-person judgment scene into second-person address: the condemned group now hears the decree as {{ar:ذُوقُوا۟}} ({{tr:dhūqū}}), a command directed at them. Because the later {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the same command frame, the opening connector begins an envelope of consequence, central declaration, and renewed command.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first imperative command opened by the consequential connector
the later coordinating connector that resumes the command frame

topics.headline: consequence becomes direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior judgment is not merely reported; it is converted into an immediate command addressed to the condemned group.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as consequential, and the local clause begins the first imperative consequence after 32:13.

topics.headline: opening connector frames the twin commands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's first connector starts a structure later resumed by the second connector before the repeated tasting command.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second imperative with the first, so the initial particle helps establish the larger command frame.

words.gloss_range: taste, undergo, or experience directly; locally an unavoidable imperative of punishment experience
words.prose: {{ar:ذُوقُوا۟}} ({{tr:dhūqū}}) is an imperative, but not one that offers the addressees a real option. The command form forces them into the grammar of participation: punishment is not only announced but tasted. Its Form I shape keeps the condemned as direct experiencers, and its first occurrence leaves the object unstated, so the command begins with suspended dread before the second {{ar:ذُوقُوا۟}} ({{tr:dhūqū}}) names {{ar:عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ}} ({{tr:ʿadhāba al-khuldi}}). The repeated sound also encloses the central abandonment clause, while same-surah and wider formulaic uses connect tasting with punishment (32:20; 32:21; 6:30; 8:35; 10:52).
words.root_gloss_range: tasting and experiential contact, extending from sensory tasting to undergoing a consequence; local Form I imperative selects direct experience

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the explicit eternal-punishment object named after the second tasting command

topics.headline: imperative makes punishment participatory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condemned are grammatically addressed as participants in an unavoidable event, not spectators of a verdict.
topics.reason: The verb is a second-person masculine plural imperative, and the local judgment scene removes any ordinary voluntary-command setting.

topics.headline: tasting makes punishment bodily
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment is framed as direct sensory experience rather than a distant legal label.
topics.reason: The local Form I imperative selects direct tasting or experience, not a causative form naming someone else as making them taste.

topics.headline: first tasting command anticipates the explicit reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb belongs to a recognized taste-punishment register and that this ayah makes the command return around its central declaration.
topics.reason: The row evidence supplies same-surah and cross-ayah anchors for the taste-punishment formula, including 32:20, 32:21, 6:30, 8:35, and 10:52.

topics.headline: first command delays its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first command's object gap, which lets the later repeated command specify the punishment with greater force.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives no explicit object for the first imperative but identifies an explicit accusative object for the second.

words.gloss_range: causal preposition prefixed to the following relative or nominalized clause
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the first tasting command accountable to a stated cause: the punishment comes because of what they forgot. Its tight clitic attachment to {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) compresses the reason into {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bimā}}), and its causal force can also carry an exchange-like sense of recompense. The later second {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) repeats the frame, so the ayah first names a specific forgotten meeting and then widens the ground to habitual deeds.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed particle that carries the causal content after the preposition
the compressed preposition-plus-particle causal unit

topics.headline: first causal preposition names the ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first command is not arbitrary; it is syntactically tied to the cause of forgotten encounter.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as governed by causal {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) after the first imperative.

topics.headline: paired causal frames bracket the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact repeated cause-frame: first forgetting the meeting, then the whole pattern of deeds.
topics.reason: The same prefixed preposition recurs before the final deed clause, creating a visible paired rationale.

words.gloss_range: relative or nominalizing particle governed by the first causal preposition
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the first rationale compressed. It can be heard as the thing they forgot or as the act of forgetting itself, and both readings keep {{ar:نَسِيتُمْ}} ({{tr:nasītum}}) inside the causal frame. That small ambiguity matters: the indictment reaches both the neglected encounter and the neglecting act. Its later counterpart before {{ar:كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:kuntum taʿmalūna}}) broadens the ayah from one omitted meeting to the full field of habitual conduct.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following verb whose clause is governed by the causal particle
the later habitual-action clause governed by the second causal frame

topics.headline: governed particle carries the first cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the causal phrase can indict both what was forgotten and the act of forgetting it.
topics.reason: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is governed by the prefixed preposition, and the local syntax allows relative or nominalizing force without changing the causal relation.

topics.headline: repeated particle broadens omission into conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two causal particles create a progression from a specific neglected meeting to comprehensive habitual deeds.
topics.reason: The later parallel causal phrase governs the habitual-action clause, giving the repeated particle a clear structural payoff.

words.gloss_range: you forgot, neglected, or left aside; locally completed culpable neglect of the named meeting
words.prose: {{ar:نَسِيتُمْ}} ({{tr:nasītum}}) presents the neglect as a completed act, and the direct object {{ar:لِقَآءَ}} ({{tr:liqāʾa}}) keeps it from sounding like vague absentmindedness. The word's range can include simple forgetting, but here the object is the meeting of their own day, so the local sense moves toward culpable disregard. Most importantly, this verb prepares the central mirror: their {{ar:نَسِيتُمْ}} ({{tr:nasītum}}) is answered by {{ar:نَسِينَٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:nasīnākum}}), matching the wider retributive pattern where forgetting is answered by being left aside (7:51; 9:67; 45:34).
